metrics.name: mcp_factory.pipeline.stage_span.duration
metrics.why: Shows where time is spent so expensive reruns are not used blindly.

metrics.name: mcp_factory.run.status_staleness
metrics.why: Tells an operator whether a run is alive, stale, or misleading.

metrics.name: mcp_factory.artifacts.required_emission_lag.duration
metrics.why: Separates a completed stage from evidence that is actually readable.

metrics.name: first_failed_boundary
metrics.why: Prevents downstream missing artifacts from being mistaken for the root cause.

metrics.name: root_blocker
metrics.why: Names the owning layer for the next bounded fix.

metrics.name: candidate_comparability_state
metrics.why: Distinguishes diagnostic output from evidence that can support comparison.

metrics.name: safe_to_compare
metrics.why: Protects against false benchmark or regression claims.

metrics.name: next_action_confidence
metrics.why: Tells the operator whether to fix, rerun, inspect, or stop.
